title: Teach the qualified proof value everywhere the old form is shown, and fence the set
action:
Slice 3 of the plan. pse-1 (commit 9ad04c73) made a bare `green` illegal at the write path and added the constant PROOF_RESULT_VALUES in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/finish_support.rs. Every place that still SHOWS `— green —` as an example now teaches the refused form. Sweep only the sites that TEACH it, then pin that set with an allowlist fence.

Teaching sites (each carries an example that must become a qualified value — pick the honest one per site, usually `green:unit`):
- packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md — the Result form example. Also state D3's three meanings once, in one short line each: live = the real product or command was driven and its observable result inspected; unit = automated tests passed; static = it compiled, type-checked, linted, or a parity/pointer check passed, with nothing executed.
- skills/bee-swarming/references/worker-details.md — REQUIRED: pse-1 acked its sync door on the promise that slice 3 touches this file. Leaving it unedited fires the same door again.
- docs/product-description/verification/lifecycle.md
- docs/product-description/verification/foundations.md
- docs/product-description/lifecycle/execution.md
- site/guide/vi/cell-lane.html — hand-authored source; site/guide/build.mjs reads it as a fragment and writes to dist/. Edit it directly, never dist/.
- packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/session_preamble/budget.rs:606 — the no-test-sentinel example. Its literal text is pinned by hooks/session_preamble/tests.rs:164, so change BOTH in the same edit or the test goes red. pse-1 left that test alone for exactly this reason.
- packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/handlers_close.rs:230 — the capCell --report example. pse-1 left it; it is yours.

NOT teaching sites — leave their bare `green` alone, it is deliberate D2 evidence that the read path stayed tolerant: packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/cells/proof.rs, verbs/work.rs, verbs/mailbox.rs (the letter fixtures at :2976 and :3010), verbs/drivers/close.rs.

Then add the FENCE to packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/proof_gate.rs — the proof domain's existing contract file, never a new file. It is an ALLOWLIST, modelled on route_class_parity.rs: it lists the teaching sites above and asserts each one still CONTAINS a qualified value from PROOF_RESULT_VALUES. Guard the allowlist against rot the way route_class_parity.rs does: a listed site that no longer holds its anchor FAILS, so a site cannot silently drop out of the set.

AFTER the prompt file changes: packages/bee/prompts/*.md is EMBEDDED in the bee binary. A prompt that differs from the built binary makes `bee dispatch prepare --kind cell` refuse with a misleading `unsupported argument shape` and kills every worker dispatch in the repo. Say so in your outcome line so the integrator rebuilds and reinstalls .bee/bin/bee at merge. Do not install a binary into the main checkout yourself.

REGEN: this cell touches packages/bee and skills/, both hashed by the release manifest. Run the full chain inside this cell, in this order: .bee/bin/bee dev render-skill-trees, then .bee/bin/bee onboard --repo-root . --apply, then .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --write. Note the trap another cell hit: .bee/expertise/* and .bee/bin/prompts/* are onboarding-INSTALLED copies — edit the source (expertise/*, packages/bee/prompts/*) and let onboard install it, never the installed copy.
acceptance: No teaching site shows a bare `— green —` example any more; the worker prompt states the three meanings. The read-path fixtures in proof.rs, work.rs, mailbox.rs and drivers/close.rs keep their bare green. proof_gate.rs carries an allowlist fence that fails when a listed site loses its qualified value.

truths: every teaching site listed in the action shows a qualified value, never a bare green
the worker prompt states the three meanings of live, unit and static
the read-path fixtures in proof.rs, work.rs, mailbox.rs and drivers/close.rs still carry their bare green
the fence lives in tests/proof_gate.rs as an allowlist and fails when a listed site loses its anchor
the outcome line names the binary reinstall the prompt change requires
the full workspace suite is green
the regen chain ran inside this cell and bee dev release-manifest --check passes
